name: Aes67OcaMediaTransportSessionAgent
comment: Adds SIP session control features to OcaMediaTransportSessionAgent. For each associated SIP-controlled session, AdaptationData shall be an OcaParameterRecord whose elements are specified in AES70-21 Table 24 (to, from, user-agent, _server, _sdpInitial, _sdpFinal).

properties.name: Sessions
properties.comment: List of SIP-controlled sessions for this CM4 instance.

methods.name: GetSIPParameterRecord
methods.comment: Gets the entire SIP parameter record from the AdaptationData property of the identified session.

arguments.name: SessionID
arguments.comment: ID of the Sessions entry being accessed.

methods.name: SetSIPParameterRecord
methods.comment: Sets the entire SIP parameter record in the AdaptationData property of the identified session.

arguments.name: SessionID
arguments.comment: ID of the Sessions entry being accessed.

methods.name: GetSIPParameter
methods.comment: Gets value of an SIP parameter from the AdaptationData property.

arguments.name: SessionID
arguments.comment: ID of the Sessions entry being accessed.

arguments.name: ParameterKey
arguments.comment: Name of the parameter to retrieve (SIP header field name, or a non-header key such as _server).

methods.name: SetSIPParameter
methods.comment: Sets value of an SIP parameter in the AdaptationData property.

arguments.name: SessionID
arguments.comment: ID of the Sessions entry being accessed.

arguments.name: ParameterKey
arguments.comment: Name of the parameter to set.
